newsitem.title: USA: Harmon Industries buys two Florida firms.
newsitem.headline: Harmon Industries buys two Florida firms.

text.p: Harmon Industries Inc said Tuesday it has acquired First Coast Signal Engineering Inc and Omaha Railway Signal Inc, both of Jacksonville, Florida.
Terms of the acquisitions were not disclosed.
First Coast Signal Engineering is a privately-held corporation with 13 engineers and has focused on engineered railroad highway crossing services for class one railroads, Harmon said.
Omaha Railway Signal has a staff of five engineers, many of whom are former rail employees, Harmon said.
Harmon supplies signal and train control products to freight and transit systems.
